newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes sharply higher on slow farm sales.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes sharply higher on slow farm sales.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed sharply higher on slow farmer selling and broad-based commission house buying, traders said.
Rice surged the 30 cent per cwt trading limit in late dealings and settled near the limit levels.
"We know supplies are tight on the farm and this is a result of it," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 800 contracts, slightly above the 789 traded Monday.
Rice closed eight to 29 cents per cwt higher, with March up 28-1/2 at $11.86-1/2.
